edits.replace:
- Decision: Use gio::Notification through the freedesktop notification service; when no daemon is present, keep in-app status and do not retry in a loop.
- Interface: OWN-PERMISSION-COORDINATOR defines in src/platform/permissioncoordinator.rs the error enum NotifyError (thiserror; exactly one variant, Unavailable, which covers both a denied and an unavailable notification service) and trait Notifier with exactly one function, notify(&self, title: &str, body: &str) -> Result<(), NotifyError>. PermissionCoordinator implements Notifier. It is created by PermissionCoordinator::new() (production probe) or PermissionCoordinator::with_probe(probe: fn() -> bool) (tests). notify makes exactly one attempt and never retries: it returns Err(NotifyError::Unavailable) without sending when the probe returns false or when gio::Application::default() is None; otherwise it builds a gio::Notification with the given title and body, calls send_notification(Some("session-complete"), &notification) on that application, and returns Ok(()). gio is used through the gtk::gio re-export. gio::Application::send_notification returns nothing, so the probe is the only way unavailability is detected. The production probe is the function notification_daemon_present() -> bool: it asks the session bus (gtk::gio::bus_get_sync, then DBusConnection::call_sync with a 500 ms timeout) org.freedesktop.DBus.NameHasOwner for the name org.freedesktop.Notifications, and returns false on any error or when the name has no owner. Features depend only on the Notifier trait; the feature test doubles live in tests/focussessiontimerfeature_tests.rs.
